name: Trailblazer Dash
tagline: One world. Five hundred trails. Never stop moving.
description: A portrait-first 3D endless runner built in Godot 4 and exported to the web. You are a Trailblazer restoring the Wayfinder Network across Avelora: five hundred campaign trails over twenty regions, a living world map that lights up as you travel, and an endless trail for when you just want to run. Swipe to change lanes, jump the hurdles, slide under the bars, collect Wayfinder Sparks and light the beacon at the end of every trail.
highlights: Trails that bend: the road, the pickups and the runner all follow one curve, and he banks into the corners
Subway-style trains seal a whole lane for twenty metres, and pits cut across every lane and need a jump
500 campaign trails across 20 regions of Avelora, every layout validated headless before it ships
A living journey map: cleared trails light the route and reveal the next region
Blender-authored runner, props and landmarks, with real 3D parallax scenery
Sparks, relics, power-up crates and a three-star objective on every trail
Portrait-first swipe controls plus keyboard, built with the Little Joy Arcade account bridge
howToPlay: Swipe left or right to change lane, up to jump, down to slide. Arrow keys and WASD work on desktop.
Three hits and the trail wins. Trains end the run on contact, so pick the free lane early.
Tap START RUNNING, then keep moving. A stumble costs your speed and one heart, not the run.
Collect sparks to meet the objective and finish under the beacon to light the next trail.
Star two and three need the objective met, not just the finish line.
